verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer is a law firm, so asking whether it ships an official CLI is a category error for this kind of product. Its client-facing tools (Contract Generator, GDHQ, the D&O portal, Catalyze) are web self-service platforms, and ChatGD is an internal tool for its own attorneys. Nothing in the evidence shows any developer or command-line interface that would make this axis apply.
